scope: Verify signed release artifacts against independently trusted Ed25519 keys, enforce monotonic revision and expiration authority checks, perform data-safe install, upgrade, and binary rollback on Linux x86_64 without discarding newer accepted data, and maintain the documented source-build alternative (N35).

observations: Implemented SignReleaseVersion, SignReleaseDirectory, VerifyTrustedRelease, InstallOrUpgradeRelease, and RollbackRelease in internal/release/upgrade.go with supporting ReleaseManifest and VerificationResult fields in internal/release/package.go.

Implemented standalone Node verifier/signer scripts/verify-release.mjs using built-in node:crypto Ed25519 keys compatible byte-for-byte with Go canonicalManifestSignPayload, plus end-to-end suite tests/release/upgrade-recovery.mjs and report docs/evidence/release-verification.json.

Verified Linux x86_64 host lifecycle across v0.1.0 (rev 1) install -> SealStore case-v1 -> v0.1.1 (rev 2) upgrade -> SealStore case-v2-newer -> binary-only rollback to v0.1.0: both case-v1 and newer accepted case-v2-newer sealed bytes (0440) remained untouched and authority highest_accepted_revision stayed at 2.

Verified all negative cases across both Go and Node verifiers: 1-byte file tamper (ErrChecksumMismatch), missing deliverable (ErrIncompleteWebOnlyArtifact), untrusted/wrong Ed25519 signer (ErrSignatureInvalid), expired and stale/replayed revision (ErrStaleOrExpiredRevision), and forbidden old-backup overwrite of newer accepted data (ErrNewerDataOverwriteForbidden), plus source/BUILD_RECIPE.json and source/breachatlas-source.tar.gz source-build alternative.
